title: IdenZero
tagline: Revolutionize background checks during hiring through issuing Soul Bound Tokens
description:
Onboarding employees is important, but verifying that what they say on their resumes is more crucial. In the modern day, companies often hassle themselves with either relying on legal documents and signatures (which honestly takes a long time) or hiring a 3rd party investigation agency. Let's fix that (and make it cooler).
Enter IdenZero, backboned by Self.xyz's powerful features like Sybil resistance and ultra-fast deployment for HRs and Talent Acquisitors. Using the decentralized digital identity made with Self, IdenZero forges a certificates minted by official authorities like registered companies and institutions over SoulBound Tokens, fusing your unique Self powered profile to your wallet. But we're not done yet! Enter "IdenScore", a next-generation practical performance score that measures you based on real-world machine coding skills adopted from your developer profiles (like GitHub). 
Motivation: think of IdenScore as Karma points, which inspire job/internship seekers to focus more on growing their career and earn in-platform credits like a game! 
Companies and institutions can use IdenZero on global-level to verify and streamline the onboarding process for fresh talent into their workforce.
how_its_made: IdenZero's frontend uses React + Vite (Typescript-based). Any user can uniquely identify themselves by using Self.xyz, We are then using rust-based packages to fetch GitHub statistics specifically the Octocrab package. We use solidity-based smart contracts to issue Soul-Bound Tokens authorised by official institutions and companies. A cool dashboard showcases the user's profile consisting of authenticity checks, and IdenScore, and in-platform pointing system based on GitHub's metrics. On the other side, we are using another solidity smart contract to ensure official authorities can deploy their job postings onto our platform. Finally, we are using Fluence VM for deploying our product.
